_comment: Typical interview loops by company type, plus rounds added for the role's focus. These are general patterns from public candidate reports, not guarantees; always confirm the process with the recruiter and check recent Glassdoor/Blind reports (linked on each card).

bigtech.label: Large tech company
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min): background, visa status, timeline, level
Technical phone screen (45–60 min): 1–2 coding problems in a shared editor
Onsite / virtual loop (4–5 × 45 min): 2 coding, 1 system design, 1 behavioral, plus a role-specific round
Team matching and hiring committee review
tips: Expect LeetCode-medium coding under time pressure; talk through tradeoffs out loud.
Behavioral rounds weigh ownership and impact; quantify results.

fintech.label: Fintech
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min)
Technical screen (60 min): practical coding (often parsing, APIs or data transforms) rather than pure puzzles
Virtual onsite (4 × 60 min): coding/bug-fix in a realistic codebase, system design (payments, ledgers, idempotency), integration exercise, behavioral
Hiring manager conversation
tips: Correctness and edge cases matter more than cleverness: think money, retries, idempotency.
Be ready to discuss data consistency and auditability.

data-infra.label: Data / infrastructure / developer-tools company
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min)
Technical screen (60 min): coding, sometimes with a systems or concurrency angle
Onsite (4–5 rounds): coding, distributed systems / architecture design, deep dive on a past project, behavioral, sometimes a take-home or pairing session
Hiring manager / values interview
tips: Know your own projects cold: expect 'why this design, what broke, what would you change'.
Brush up on storage formats, partitioning, consistency, and failure handling.

ai-lab.label: AI lab / AI-native company
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min): motivation and mission fit
Technical screen or online assessment (60–90 min): practical coding, often multi-part and progressively harder
Virtual onsite (4–6 rounds): coding, system design, ML/LLM fundamentals or eval design, project deep dive, culture/values
Reference checks
tips: Expect questions on LLM evaluation, failure modes and safety; ExtendDDG is a strong story here.
Practical, production-quality code beats puzzle tricks.

consumer.label: Consumer / product company
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min)
Technical screen (45–60 min): coding
Onsite (4 rounds): coding, system design, product sense / collaboration, behavioral
Hiring manager chat
tips: Tie technical decisions to user and business impact.
Have a point of view on the company's product.

healthtech.label: Health tech
rounds: Recruiter screen (30 min)
Technical screen (60 min): coding or SQL, sometimes a take-home
Onsite (3–5 rounds): coding, data/system design with privacy constraints, domain discussion, behavioral
Hiring manager / cross-functional interview
tips: Your CommonSpirit experience (27 hospitals, clinical stakeholders) is a direct advantage; lead with it.
Mention HIPAA-aware data handling and data-quality safeguards.

quant.label: Quant trading / investment firm
rounds: Recruiter screen
Online assessment or technical phone screen: algorithms, probability or mental math
Multiple technical rounds (3–6): coding in depth, data structures, probability/statistics, systems
Final round with senior engineers / partners
tips: Expect a high bar on algorithms and probability.
Precision and clear reasoning matter more than speed.

data-eng: SQL round: window functions, joins, deduplication, gaps-and-islands
Data pipeline / modeling design: batch vs. streaming, idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality
ml-eng: ML fundamentals: bias/variance, metrics, feature leakage, evaluation
ML system design: training + serving pipeline, monitoring and drift, or an LLM/RAG evaluation design
swe: DSA coding: arrays/hashing, graphs, trees, intervals
System design: APIs, data storage, caching, scaling
data-sci: Statistics & experimentation: A/B test design, power, pitfalls
Product analytics case plus SQL/Python exercise
